reference.name: Stockfish 19
reference.tablebase_policy: Explicit matched policy required; initial no-tablebase comparison and later matched-coverage comparison must be separate

match.game_history_policy: Begin at supplied start position and mirror the pinned referee's exact history and counter semantics.
match.adjudication: Use the pinned referee; no evaluation-based early termination.
match.ply_cap_policy: Record the pinned referee's exact treatment of initial FEN ply; do not silently change it.
match.failure_policy: Candidate errors count as losses; documented infrastructure failures use symmetric preregistered reruns.

statistics.unit: opening pair; cluster by opening family when required
statistics.final_holdout_access: Only after candidate and analysis freeze

costs.notes: Record both total resource consumption and elapsed time.
